### 3. bl-0023

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen |
| Diagnosis | Row confirmed. The `apply_code_action` docstring at `src/python_refactor_mcp/tool_registry.py:619` says to omit `action_title` to list available actions. But `_pick_code_action` at `src/python_refactor_mcp/tools/refactoring/code_actions.py:27-28` returns `actions[0]` when `action_title is None`, and `apply_code_action` (`code_actions.py:73-83`) previews that first action, or writes it when `apply=True`. So an omitted title can silently apply an arbitrary fix. Root cause: (a) the None fallback in `_pick_code_action`; (b) the return model `RefactorResult` (`src/python_refactor_mcp/models.py:287-300`) has no field for a list of titles. The existing test `tests/unit/test_refactoring_tools.py:242,258` calls without `action_title` and depends on the first-action fallback. The only other caller of `_pick_code_action` is `organize_imports` (`code_actions.py:112`), which always passes an explicit title. |
| Approach | Implement the documented contract. (1) `models.py`: after `RefactorResult` (line 300), add `class CodeActionResult(RefactorResult)` with `available_actions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)`, documented as the titles Pyright offers at the position. (2) `code_actions.py`: add an `_action_titles(actions)` helper and reuse it for the unmatched-title `ToolInputError` message (`code_actions.py:39-43`). Narrow `_pick_code_action` to a required `action_title: str`, dropping the None branch and fixing its docstring. `apply_code_action` returns `CodeActionResult`. When `action_title is None` and actions exist, return empty `edits`/`files_affected`, `applied=False`, `available_actions=<titles>` and a description like `N code action(s) available; pass action_title to preview or apply one`. Never apply here, even with `apply=True`. The no-actions path (`code_actions.py:66-72`) returns a `CodeActionResult` with `available_actions=[]`. The titled path wraps the `post_apply_diagnostics` result with `CodeActionResult.model_validate({**result.model_dump(), 'available_actions': titles})`. (3) `tool_registry.py:611-623`: change the return annotation to `CodeActionResult`, add it to the `models` import block (`tool_registry.py:49-98`), and reword the docstring: omitting `action_title` returns the available titles in `available_actions` without previewing or applying. (4) `docs/tool-reference.md:81`: set the return column to `CodeActionResult`, as the drift gate `tests/unit/test_doc_tool_count_drift.py:220-247` requires. Rejected alternatives: a description-only fix (keeps the silent first-action apply); titles packed into the `description` string (not machine-readable); an optional field on the shared `RefactorResult` (widens the output schema of about 30 tools). |
